CASE-005.customer_response: Your home gateway and internet connection are operating normally, and there is no outage in your area. Because the issue affects only one phone, please forget the home Wi-Fi network on that phone, restart the phone, and join the network again using the current Wi-Fi password. If it still cannot join, let us know the exact error message shown on the phone.
CASE-005.internal_notes: DEV-001 is online with good signal, local/WAN/DNS connectivity, and active service. No District Aurora outage. Symptoms support a phone-specific Wi-Fi join issue rather than a gateway or regional-service fault.
